name: Sakura Wabi
tagline: Warm washi-paper off-white with soft ink greys, hairline rules, a single sakura-pink dot and airy light Cormorant Garamond serif, with vertical title type (extended from a single-slide specimen)
occasion: tea, craft or ceramics brand story

palette.description: washi off-white with charcoal ink and one restrained sakura pink accent

typography.label: Inter
typography.style: light elegant serif at large sizes, vertical display title, tiny widely tracked sans labels

best_for: Calm, text-light decks about craft, philosophy, hospitality and slow living. Generous empty space and one soft pink accent carry the mood.
avoid_for: Loud sales pitches or dense data decks that need strong contrast and many colors.
